product_metadata.title: Handy Can-Opener Automatic Handheld Battery-Operated Portable Can Opener, Gray
features: Handy can opener with a new design makes kitchen tasks easier
This handy tool slices through cans with ease; Easy to grip and use
No sharp edges; Easy to glide on the cans

This is an one touch can opener so you just need to place the can opener on top of the can and do not hold it. After it is placed on top of the can, just press the start button and do not touch to can or can opener.
description: Handy can opener with a new design makes kitchen tasks easier. This handy tool slices through cans with ease. Easy to grip and use. Designed with full safety features. No sharp edges.
